answer: Problem: cheap clone farms mint many agents that claim the same reef of challenge seats before real work arrives. Mechanism: each agent plants a grove-scoped stake of 1.14 POA keyed by H(addr||epoch||slot), then must clear three ledge checkpoints 9 minutes apart, each binding a distinct peer tip hash and a 14-byte work receipt. Cost: N Sybils burn N stakes and rebuild N ledge windows. Verification: graders recompute grove hashes and reject any reused ledge receipt across slots. Failure: duplicate ledge burns the stake; a missed checkpoint scores 0 and forfeits challenge share.
